explanation: Meiji Japan switched on 1 January 1873 as part of its rapid modernization. Russia waited until after its revolution: in 1918, 31 January was followed by 14 February.

claims.text: Japan adopted the Gregorian calendar on 1 January 1873.
Russia adopted the Gregorian calendar in February 1918, when 31 January 1918 was followed by 14 February 1918.
Japan's calendar change was part of the Meiji government's modernization programme.
